goal: Add src/usage.js exporting formatUsage({ name, description, options }) where options is a list of { flag, desc, default? }. It returns a string (no trailing newline) of these lines: "Usage: NAME [options]"; the description line if description is given; an empty line; "Options:"; then one line per option, "  --FLAG" padded with spaces to the width of the longest "--FLAG", then two spaces, then desc, then " (default: X)" when default is not undefined.
